profile.name: Tom
profile.tagline: Software Engineer building developer tools, cross-platform CLI & desktop utilities, visual web editors, and game plugins.
profile.bio: I build fast, practical tools across Rust, C++, TypeScript, Python, and Java—ranging from repository-native task trackers and Nextcloud automation utilities to visual node editors, virtual tabletops, and Minecraft Paper server plugins.

projects.label: opentasks
projects.description: Repository-native, database-free task and planning management tool (ot) storing tasks, epics, and dependency graphs as Markdown with YAML frontmatter in Git.

projects.label: NextcloudUploadTool
projects.description: Fast, pipe-friendly Rust CLI (nut) and native Tauri v2 desktop GUI for streaming WebDAV uploads to Nextcloud and generating instant OCS public share & direct-download links.

projects.label: ThemeTool
projects.description: Interactive web tool for generating component color palettes, previewing light/dark UI themes, and converting tokens across Tailwind and design systems.

projects.label: MonsterCards
projects.description: Create, import, and organize 5e-compatible monster statblocks across devices with Tetra-Cube statblock import and cloud synchronization.

projects.label: NodeEditor
projects.description: Configurable, schema-driven visual node graph editor for React inspired by Blender and Unreal Engine Blueprints with Bezier wires and live topological evaluation.

projects.label: EditorTemplate
projects.description: Modular Next.js and TypeScript workspace template for building rich visual editors and interactive web applications.

projects.label: OldBearBattles
projects.description: Lightweight, zero-install, mobile-friendly virtual tabletop (VTT) and tactical battlemap system with HTML5 Canvas, WebRTC voice chat, and D&D Beyond character sync.

projects.label: JTest
projects.description: A Jasmine-inspired C++ unit testing library featuring expressive describe/it/expect BDD syntax, matchers, and zero-boilerplate test suites.

projects.label: TinyTest
projects.description: Minimal, lightweight C++ unit testing framework with setup/teardown hooks, custom comparators, conditional skipping, and CMake FetchContent integration.

projects.label: Metropolis
projects.description: Minecraft city generation plugin that automatically expands protected player home plots, multi-level stacked plots, and road networks with WorldGuard integration.

projects.label: ScoreKeeper
projects.description: Minecraft Paper 26.2/26.3 plugin (Java 25) that tracks player scores in named buckets for server events, timed high-score runs, and companion plugins.

projects.label: MobScores
projects.description: Companion plugin for ScoreKeeper on Minecraft Paper 26.2/26.3 that awards configurable points for entity kills during server events and runs.
